errorCodes.meaning: The submitted `domain` is not a known hosting domain on this consumer. See [the category conventions](../../../../_shared/0.1/CONVENTIONS.md#2-unknown-domain-error).

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: Every matching domain's terms. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.

policies.description: The domains' terms, by domain name. Empty when no domain has any — that is, when every domain is closed to self-registration.

Response.title: DID Management — Account Policy List — response payload

admissions.description: The admission evidence the domain accepts: `invite`, an invite from did-management/account/invite/issue; `voucher`, a voucher from one of `trustedIssuers`. Empty only when `enabled` is `false`.

domain.description: The hosting domain the terms apply to.

enabled.description: Whether the domain admits new registrations now. `false` closes it without discarding its terms: registrations are refused with `registrationClosed`, while existing accounts keep their DIDs, renew and expire as before.

graceDays.description: Days a disabled account is kept, and can be restored by its holder's renewal, before it is purged.

inactivityDays.description: Days an account may go without a liveness signal before its DIDs are disabled. `0`: accounts on this domain do not expire.

maxDidCount.description: The most DIDs one self-registered account may hold, its own included. Absent: the service's ordinary per-account limit, as for any account an administrator creates.

maxPendingInvites.description: The most invites that may be pending for the domain at once.

maxRegistrations.description: The most self-registered accounts the domain holds at once.

maxTotalSizeBytes.description: The most bytes of DID content one self-registered account may hold. Absent: the service's ordinary per-account limit.

pathPrefixes.description: Every DID a self-registered account holds sits under one of these `/`-separated prefixes, matched on whole segments. Empty: any path the domain's grammar admits.

trustedIssuers.description: The authorising parties — trust communities, or any other party the operator chooses — whose vouchers admit a registrant here. Non-empty exactly when `admissions` includes `voucher`; no DID appears twice.

updatedAt.description: When the terms last changed. Set by the service; ignored in a `set` request.

updatedBy.description: The administrator who last changed them, or `operator` for terms seeded from the service's configuration. Set by the service; ignored in a `set` request.

TrustedIssuer.description: An authorising party whose `DidHostingVoucher`s admit a registrant.

did.description: The party's DID: a voucher's `issuer`. A `did:scid` is compared without its `src`.

label.description: The operator's name for the party. Not published.

TrustedIssuer.title: TrustedIssuer

schema.description: An administrator reads the self-registration terms of the hosting domains: open or closed, the trusted authorising parties with their labels, and the limits. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

domain.description: Only this domain's terms. Absent: every domain that has terms.

schema.title: DID Management — Account Policy List — payload
